results.title: Orcas and dolphins were recorded hunting salmon together off British Columbia
results.description: Off the shores of British Columbia, a remarkable display of teamwork unfolded as killer whales and dolphins joined forces to hunt. Utilizing powerful echolocation, dolphins aided the whales in pinpointing fish in the deep blue. After the whales feasted on their catch, they allowed the dolphins to enjoy the leftovers. This cooperative hunting behavior sheds light on the complex relationships among ocean predators.
